'Each hero puts all cards in their arsenal on the bottom of their deck and creates a Ponder token. / Go again.'

Go again is a printed keyword (printed_keywords) firing from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored; re-authoring it would be a defect.

'Each hero': PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM handles ONE player per effect and DEFAULTS TO OPPONENT (effect_types.py:2334 - the Disable printings were its first users), so 'player': 'SELF' is passed EXPLICITLY on the first node; omitting it would bottom my own card twice and never touch the opponent's arsenal (the exact defect recorded on sunkwater_exoshell). The FAB arsenal holds at most one card, so one node per hero IS 'all cards in their arsenal'; an empty arsenal early-returns without touching later effects (effect_types.py:2350-2352).

Release note ('Each hero creates a Ponder token regardless of whether they've put a card from their arsenal on the bottom of their deck'): the tokens are separate unconditional CREATE_TOKEN nodes, not riders on the puts - a no-op put cannot suppress them.

CREATE_TOKEN reads token/count/player (effect_types.py:1942-2013); count defaults to 1. json/tokens/ponder.json exists, so no MissingCardImplementation at resolution.

No gaps; every clause expressible.
